INSERT INTO edu.quiz_learning_outcomes (quiz_id, learning_outcome_id) VALUES
(#{quizId}, #{learningOutcomeId})
ON CONFLICT (quiz_id, learning_outcome_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT learning_outcome_id FROM edu.quiz_learning_outcomes WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY learning_outcome_id

SELECT lo.id AS learning_outcome_id, CONCAT(glo.code, '.', lo.prefix_number) AS learning_outcome_code, lo.description AS learning_outcome_description, glo.id AS group_learning_outcome_id, glo.code AS group_learning_outcome_name, glo.description AS group_learning_outcome_description FROM edu.quiz_learning_outcomes qlo JOIN edu.learning_outcomes lo ON lo.id = qlo.learning_outcome_id LEFT JOIN edu.group_learning_outcomes glo ON glo.id = lo.group_learning_outcome_id WHERE qlo.quiz_id = #{quizId} AND lo.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY glo.sort_order NULLS FIRST, lo.sort_order
